QUALITY & RISK

Make the work
reviewable.

The assignment brief sets the quality checks. Evidence, assumptions, responsibilities and limitations stay visible from scoping through handover.

ENGAGEMENT-LEVEL QA

Five checks.
One evidence trail.

These are the proposed working controls for a scoped engagement. They are not a claim of independent audit, certification or donor approval.

  1. 01

    Agree the decision

    Confirm the terms of reference, intended user, deadline, outputs, source materials and review responsibilities.

  2. 02

    Trace the evidence

    Separate supplied data, cited evidence, estimates and assumptions. Record the source and the date for material inputs.

  3. 03

    Challenge the logic

    Check calculations, internal consistency, scenario choices and which assumptions could change the conclusion.

  4. 04

    Review against scope

    Check the draft against the agreed requirements, deliverables, citation needs and version history; identify unresolved issues.

  5. 05

    Handover limits clearly

    State what the analysis can support, what remains uncertain and which decisions or checks sit with the client or authority.

CONFIDENTIALITY & DATA

Agree handling before transfer.

At scoping, agree the purpose, minimum necessary materials, access, retention and handover method. This website does not accept uploads or store enquiry content. Do not send sensitive or procurement-restricted files through the public form.

CONFLICTS & ROLE CLARITY

Surface overlaps early.

Relevant prior or current roles, partner relationships and potential conflicts should be disclosed during scoping and addressed before acceptance. The role, independence and limits of any review are stated in the agreed scope.

SAFEGUARDS & FIDUCIARY REQUIREMENTS

Match the actual terms.

Safeguard, fiduciary or compliance requirements are reviewed against the specific terms of reference and the assigned role. This page does not claim accreditation or institutional approval for those functions.

EVIDENCE & PUBLIC CLAIMS

Attribute what can be shown.

Assignment descriptions are limited to documented roles and permitted information. Client names do not imply endorsement; confidential work can be described at an appropriate anonymised level.

THE NEXT DECISION

Review the fit before work begins.

Share the decision, requirements and available evidence. The scope can then identify the right review steps and boundaries.
